description: Finds which tracked vendor MCP servers list a tool with a given name, and the kind each is counted as. By default it matches the whole name, ignoring case; with match set to 'contains' it finds names containing the text (at least 3 characters). Searches only the servers the tracker follows, at their latest listing.
name: find_tool

data_as_of.description: When the tracker data was published.

source.description: The tracker page this answer is drawn from.

title: Find a tool by name
